metadata.title: Chapter 15: Probability
metadata.subtitle: The Ultimate Board Exam Mastery Guide
metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity Supreme Intelligence
learning_outcomes: Understand the theoretical probability of an event.
Solve problems based on tossing coins and throwing dice.
Solve problems based on drawing cards from a well-shuffled deck.

ai_context.learning_goal: Make abstract probability feel real. Use the 'Socratic Discovery Arc' to build intuition before giving formulas.
common_misconceptions: Students think the probability of an event can be greater than 1.
Students get confused with the sample space of tossing 2 or 3 coins.
Students struggle with the composition of a standard deck of cards.

blocks.content: Imagine you are playing a board game with your friends. You need exactly a 6 on the dice to win. What are your chances? Is it pure luck, or is there a mathematical way to predict it? Welcome to the fascinating world of **Probability (प्रायिकता / સંભાવના)**!
The Probability Scale: Probability always lies between 0 and 1. 0 means impossible, 1 means certain.
blocks.alt_text: A glowing scale from 0 to 1 showing Impossible, Unlikely, Even Chance, Likely, and Certain.

blocks.content:
**Theoretical Probability (सैद्धांतिक प्रायिकता):**
The probability of an event E, written as P(E), is defined as:
P(E) = (Number of outcomes favorable to E) / (Number of all possible outcomes of the experiment)

*Example - Tossing a Coin (सिक्का उछालना):* When you toss a fair coin, possible outcomes are Head (H) or Tail (T). So, P(Head) = 1/2.

💡 **Teacher's Secret:** When tossing **2 coins**, the sample space is {HH, HT, TH, TT}. When tossing **3 coins**, it is {HHH, HHT, HTH, HTT, THH, THT, TTH, TTT}. A quick formula for total outcomes is **2ⁿ**, where n is the number of coins!

🔥 **BOARD EXAM HOT TOPIC:** Throwing Two Dice (दो पासे फेंकना)

When you throw 2 dice, the total number of outcomes is **6 × 6 = 36**. 
*Board Trick:* They often ask for the sum of numbers on the two dice. Remember, the sum ranges from 2 (1+1) to 12 (6+6). Draw a 6x6 table in rough work if you get confused!
A standard deck of 52 playing cards (ताश के पत्ते).
blocks.alt_text: A visual breakdown of 52 cards into 4 suits: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs.

blocks.content:
**The Card Deck Breakdown:**
Total 52 cards = 26 Red + 26 Black.
4 Suits (13 cards each): Spades (♠ Black), Clubs (♣ Black), Hearts (♥ Red), Diamonds (♦ Red).
Each suit has: Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, King.
**Face Cards:** Jack, Queen, King. Total face cards = 3 × 4 = 12.

blocks.question: What is the probability of a sure event?
blocks.question_hi: एक निश्चित घटना की प्रायिकता क्या होती है?
blocks.explanation: The probability of an event that is certain to happen is 1.
blocks.explanation_hi: जो घटना निश्चित रूप से घटित होनी है, उसकी प्रायिकता 1 होती है।

blocks.question: Which of the following cannot be the probability of an event?
blocks.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन किसी घटना की प्रायिकता नहीं हो सकती है?
blocks.explanation: Probability of an event cannot be negative. It always lies between 0 and 1.
blocks.explanation_hi: किसी घटना की प्रायिकता ऋणात्मक (negative) नहीं हो सकती। यह हमेशा 0 और 1 के बीच होती है।

blocks.question: If P(E) = 0.05, what is the probability of 'not E'?
blocks.question_hi: यदि P(E) = 0.05 है, तो 'E नहीं' की प्रायिकता क्या है?

blocks.question: A die is thrown once. What is the probability of getting a prime number?
blocks.question_hi: एक पासे को एक बार फेंका जाता है। अभाज्य संख्या (prime number) प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: Possible outcomes are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Prime numbers are 2, 3, 5 (3 outcomes). Probability = 3/6 = 1/2.

blocks.question: Two coins are tossed simultaneously. What is the probability of getting exactly one head?
blocks.question_hi: दो सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला जाता है। ठीक एक चित (head) आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: Sample space = {HH, HT, TH, TT}. Outcomes with exactly one head = {HT, TH}. Probability = 2/4 = 1/2.
blocks.explanation_hi: प्रतिदर्श समष्टि (Sample space) = {HH, HT, TH, TT}। ठीक एक चित वाले परिणाम = {HT, TH}। प्रायिकता = 2/4 = 1/2।

blocks.question: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. What is the probability of getting a face card?
blocks.question_hi: 52 ताश के पत्तों की एक अच्छी तरह से फेंटी गई गड्डी में से एक पत्ता निकाला जाता है। फेस कार्ड (चित्र वाला पत्ता) प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: There are 12 face cards (4 Jacks, 4 Queens, 4 Kings). Probability = 12/52 = 3/13.

blocks.question: A bag contains 3 red balls and 5 black balls. A ball is drawn at random. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
blocks.question_hi: एक थैले में 3 लाल गेंदें और 5 काली गेंदें हैं। यादृच्छया एक गेंद निकाली जाती है। लाल गेंद निकलने की प्रायिकता क्या है?

blocks.question: The sum of the probabilities of all the elementary events of an experiment is:
blocks.question_hi: किसी प्रयोग की सभी प्रारंभिक घटनाओं की प्रायिकताओं का योग होता है:
blocks.explanation: The sum of probabilities of all elementary events is always 1.
blocks.explanation_hi: सभी प्रारंभिक घटनाओं की प्रायिकताओं का योग हमेशा 1 होता है।

blocks.question: Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability of getting a sum of 8?
blocks.question_hi: दो पासों को एक साथ फेंका जाता है। योग 8 आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: Favorable outcomes for sum 8: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2). Total = 5. Probability = 5/36.

blocks.question: What is the probability of drawing a king of red colour from a standard deck of 52 cards?
blocks.question_hi: 52 ताश के पत्तों की गड्डी में से लाल रंग का बादशाह निकलने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: There are 2 red kings (King of Hearts and King of Diamonds). Probability = 2/52 = 1/26.
blocks.explanation_hi: 2 लाल बादशाह होते हैं (पान का बादशाह और ईंट का बादशाह)। प्रायिकता = 2/52 = 1/26।

blocks.question: If three coins are tossed simultaneously, what is the probability of getting at least two heads?
blocks.question_hi: यदि तीन सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला जाता है, तो कम से कम दो चित (heads) आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: Sample space has 8 outcomes. Outcomes with at least 2 heads: HHH, HHT, HTH, THH. Total = 4. Probability = 4/8 = 1/2.
blocks.explanation_hi: प्रतिदर्श समष्टि में 8 परिणाम होते हैं। कम से कम 2 चित वाले परिणाम: HHH, HHT, HTH, THH। कुल = 4. प्रायिकता = 4/8 = 1/2।

blocks.question: A number is chosen at random from numbers 1 to 20. Find the probability that it is a multiple of 3.
blocks.question_hi: 1 से 20 तक की संख्याओं में से यादृच्छया एक संख्या चुनी जाती है। इसके 3 का गुणज (multiple) होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
blocks.explanation: Multiples of 3 from 1 to 20 are 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18. Total = 6. Probability = 6/20 = 3/10.

blocks.question: The probability of an impossible event is:
blocks.question_hi: एक असंभव घटना की प्रायिकता होती है:
blocks.explanation: An event that cannot happen has 0 probability.
blocks.explanation_hi: जो घटना घटित नहीं हो सकती, उसकी प्रायिकता 0 होती है।

blocks.question: A game of chance consists of spinning an arrow which comes to rest pointing at one of the numbers 1 to 8. What is the probability that it will point at a number greater than 2?
blocks.question_hi: संयोग के एक खेल में एक तीर को घुमाया जाता है, जो 1 से 8 तक की किसी एक संख्या पर रुकता है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह 2 से बड़ी संख्या पर रुकेगा?
blocks.explanation: Numbers greater than 2 are 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. Total = 6 numbers. Probability = 6/8 = 3/4.

blocks.question: A card is drawn from a deck of 52 cards. What is the probability of getting a spade or an ace?
blocks.question_hi: 52 ताश के पत्तों की गड्डी में से एक पत्ता निकाला जाता है। हुकुम (spade) या इक्का (ace) प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
blocks.explanation: There are 13 spades and 3 other aces (since Ace of spades is already counted). Total = 16. Probability = 16/52 = 4/13.
blocks.explanation_hi: 13 हुकुम के पत्ते हैं और 3 अन्य इक्के हैं (क्योंकि हुकुम का इक्का पहले ही गिना जा चुका है)। कुल = 16. प्रायिकता = 16/52 = 4/13।
